name: rpm-dashboard-workspace
description: RPM Dashboard monorepo workspace — run both frontend and backend from root

scripts.dev: start "RPM Backend" cmd /k "cd rpm-dashboard-main && npm run dev" && start "RPM Frontend" cmd /k "cd rpm-dashboard-frontend-main && npm run dev"
scripts.install:all: cd rpm-dashboard-main && npm install && cd ../rpm-dashboard-frontend-main && npm install
